youtube.aciklama: In lateral medullary, or Wallenberg, syndrome from PICA or vertebral artery occlusion, vertigo and nystagmus may come with same-side facial numbness, hoarseness, trouble swallowing and hiccups. Reduced pain and temperature sensation on the opposite side of the body is typical. These signs are not always obvious, so they are asked about, and any central sign calls for emergency physician evaluation.
